## Selection

Arnolfini's Arnold Art Cart is a distinct indoor weekday option, not a repeat of the 14 September National Trust campaign or the 13 September Arts Trail.

Freshly checked official facts:

- Arnold Art Cart is free and available Tuesday–Sunday, 11:00–18:00, on Arnolfini's second floor.
- It contains creative materials, exhibition-inspired activities and table-top easels.
- It is a self-led resource for families/everyone, not a staffed workshop. Materials can vary.
- Arnolfini admission is free. The venue offers optional advance booking and keeps drop-in spaces available.
- Lifts serve all floors and public spaces have level access. The quayside has uneven cobbles; smoother approaches are available from Prince Street and Narrow Quay.
- Address: 16 Narrow Quay, Bristol BS1 4QA.
- DoNext fit of roughly ages 3–12 is editorial, not an organiser age limit. Children need their grown-up.

Primary sources checked:

- https://arnolfini.org.uk/whatson/arnold-art-cart/
